targets.metric: Patient age at first in-window service, distinct patients
targets.denominator: patients with qualifying service; adult at each service
targets.tolerance: Each share within 0.04 absolute; cells n<200 use 95% Wilson interval review
targets.provenance: Configured fictional hospital catchment, not a US prevalence estimate

targets.metric: Completed uncensored IPD mean LOS in days
targets.denominator: Completed IPD excluding opening-only AR contexts
targets.provenance: Configured adult pathway mix; 5.2 clipped occupied days per intersecting episode is a separate budget identity

targets.metric: Share of completed IPD stays over 10 days
targets.provenance: Configured long-stay component; not a measured benchmark

targets.metric: Share of patients with >=2 distinct intersecting encounters
targets.denominator: Distinct active patients, not demographic versions

targets.metric: Coverage at service, by distinct encounter
targets.tolerance: Each share within 0.05 absolute; cohort/age compatibility checked independently

targets.metric: Original claims with initial full/partial denial
targets.denominator: Current-period originals with observed first adjudication, not attempts or unresolved claims
Eligible live discharges with full 30-day followup; continuous transfers excluded

targets.metric: Exact duplicate normalized note bodies after removing identity/date fields
targets.denominator: At least 100 notes per evaluated document_type
targets.provenance: Text-diversity design threshold; factual consistency remains a hard rule

targets.tolerance: Top-100+OTHER total variation <=0.10 against configured source weights; >=300 distinct given names and >=1000 surnames among 20000 patients; no uniqueness requirement for names
targets.provenance: SSA birth-cohort given names and Census 2010 surnames; public aggregates only

targets.metric: Productive RN hours / configured required RN hours
targets.provenance: 5.5 RN hours per patient-day is a modeling input, not a staffing recommendation; shortage scenarios evaluated separately

targets.metric: Peak/trough monthly ED arrival rate per active day, pooled network
targets.denominator: All 36 months; compare rates rather than raw unequal-month counts
targets.provenance: Configured seasonality plus shocks; facility curves differ
